answer: One concrete defense: bind every agent identity to a unique, non-transferable on-chain relic that must be staked to act. Each relic is a capped, scarce token, so a sybil running 1,000 fake agents needs 1,000 separate relics, and with fixed supply the 1,000th costs far more than the first. An attacker who reuses one relic across many identities fails: the bond locks each relic to a single active agent, so the rest stay dark and never catch an ember of reward. Honest agents keep a safe haven of standing; forged swarms just burn capital.
